journey.name: Trends
journey.description: The Log's All time opens Trends: the time and weight a week against a usual week, the records set and a test's results at its bell. Run on an install with a few weeks of workouts and Lift sessions, at least one of them a snatch test done twice with the same bell (TrendsAcceptanceTest seeds the same on the JVM).

actions.action: Scroll to the foot of the All time card and tap "Trends"
Verify that the page is titled "Trends" and reads "Since" over a date twelve weeks back
Verify that "Time a week" draws a bar a week, this week outlined, a dashed line across at the usual week, and under it "This week" with the usual beside it
Verify that "Lifted a week" is there with its weight in the unit Settings weighs in, and that "Heart load a week" and "Heart recovery" show only if a sensor read a workout
Scroll down and verify that "Records" counts the records set in 12 weeks and lists the newest first, each with its lift, the record and its date
Verify that "Tests" names the snatch test, its latest result with its bell ("… reps with 16 kg"), the first and latest joined by an arrow, and a line of the attempts
Tap "Back" and verify that the Log is on "All time"
On a tablet held sideways, open Trends again and verify that it opens beside the log with a close button in place of Back
